name: Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer

fee.note: USD list price plus tax where applicable. Every attempt is paid.

exam.format: 40–50 multiple choice and multiple select questions in 2 hours, online-proctored or at a test center (Pearson VUE since March 2026). English and Japanese. No prerequisites; Google recommends 3+ years of industry experience including 1+ year designing and managing solutions on Google Cloud.

scope: Designing, building, securing and operating data processing systems on Google Cloud: ingestion and processing, storage, preparing data for analysis, and automating data workloads.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.
caveats: Google reports pass/fail only and does not publish a passing score.
Certified holders can renew with a shorter renewal exam (1 hour, 20 questions, $100, with its own guide) or through designated courses and skill badges in Google Skills, which add one year.

access.retake: Up to four attempts in two years: wait 14 days after the first failure, 60 after the second and 365 after the third.
